notes.title: Major game update.
notes.content:
The beginning of my game is my own creation.

Thank you for your interest in my game. I don't know how to thank you for your support, which makes my life so much better. Thank you for playing and having fun. For example, I make sure that you can have fun and do what you want to do (today I've incorporated a menu system into my game so that players can customize their gameplay.)
Thank you for advertising me, it means a lot to me to be able to continue to provide you with regular content.
